name: Kartikey Hebbar
stackLines: Full-Stack Engineering | Distributed Systems | Agentic AI | System Design
bio: I'm a Software Engineer with a passion for building scalable and efficient systems. I'm currently working at NetScout Systems, Inc., where I contribute to the development of some of their flagship products such as nGeniusONE and Omnis Cyber Intelligence.
I like to identify myself as a technology generalist, with a keen interest in Full-Stack Engineering, Distributed Systems, Agentic AI, and System Design.

I stepped into technology as a hobbyist with a love for video games but a limited access to computers while growing up. I wrote my first line of code when I started as a freshmen at Bangalore Institute of Technology, where I pursued a Bachelor's in Telecommunications Engineering. This completely changed the trajectory of my career and pushed me towards exploring the world of software development.

After working in automation, IAM Ops and web infrastructure for about 2.5 years, I returned back to academia to pursue a Master of Science in Software Engineering Systems at Northeastern University, Boston. During this time, my trait of being a generalist helped me explore and understand the various facets of software development and engineering. But it also helped me understand more about myself and develop a deeper interest in certain areas where I have been working on to become a specialist.

I started working again in the industry from 2025 after graduating and rejoined NetScout Systems, where I had an internship stint a summer before that. Now, most of my time at NetScout is spent working on new features for nGeniusONE and Omnis Cyber Intelligence, redesigning end-to-end workflows for better user experience and architecting systems for new products.

Lately, I've been exploring self-hosted Small-Language Models (SLMs) and their applications in enterprise software using Agentic AI with robust harness. I also spend a lot of my time after work exploring AI and Distributed Systems by building interested projects.
Beyond code, you'll find me reading books, playing video games, geeking out over entrepreneurship, and watching soccer. Sometimes, I trade my keyboard for a guitar to jam a little!
Always excited to connect, collaborate, and build things that make a real impact. Let's chat!
